Dill Cucumber Salad
By: Cristie Hurd
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:11pm

Ingredients




4 cucumbers, peeled and 1/4" sliced
1/2 cup sour cream
1/4 cup white vinegar
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
2 teaspoons dill

Preparation

1 In a medium-sized bowl, gently stir the ingredients together. Chill for several hours before serving.

About


When cucumbers came in fast from the garden my mom quickly turned them into this cool, refreshing cucumber salad. She never measured anything, and for this salad I don't measure much either. Feel free to change the proportions of the ingredients to suit. This cucumber salad is fast to make and was always a winner at our Labor Day block parties.
